title: 7S.3 single-frame INSERT rollback checkpoint fast slice
mode: Local implementation slice with generated in-memory controls
scope: Avoid the facade's growing compound writer snapshot for an ordinary INSERT that emits one frame and has no ATTRIB or SEQEND children.
Preserve caller rollback state, owner/insert indexes, and full fallback for compound/unsupported paths.

behavior: For no-attribute/no-sequence INSERTs with a writer that advertises retained entity rollback, capture the caller's pre-allocation state and use encodeEntityForWrite instead of checkpointing all writer ledgers in the facade.
Restore original caller fields after failed encoding; on success replace the post-normalization mutation journal entry with the original pre-write state for implicit and outer transaction rollback.

Leave attribute-bearing INSERTs, preserved legacy empty sequences, and writers without entity rollback support on the existing comprehensive transaction path; dwgWriter15 retains its custom-class-associated full fallback.
testChanges: Extends the existing --block-owner-membership-index selector with an ordinary single-frame INSERT on a clean AC1015 writer and asserts zero full checkpoints plus emitted-object, block-owner, and insert-reference membership.
Injects a missing frame receipt and verifies output bytes, object map, emitted-handle index, owner ledgers, insert-reference ledgers, caller handle, and SEQEND fields are restored.

Writes an auto-handle INSERT inside a caller-mutation-tracking transaction and rolls back; verifies the caller's original zero handle/SEQEND metadata and all frame/index state return to baseline, with only the explicit transaction's checkpoint.

limitations: The zero-full-checkpoint assertion is deterministic work evidence, not wall-clock throughput measurement.
The fast facade path covers only no-attribute/no-sequence INSERTs; compound attributes and preserved legacy sequences intentionally retain full snapshots.
The shared worktree is broadly dirty and repository Git metadata is read-only; this slice is uncommitted.
nextReadinessSlice: Keep attribute-bearing INSERT and POLYLINE/VERTEX sequence rollback comprehensive; audit the next high-cardinality path for a bounded append/rollback boundary before changing it.
